item.title: Floyd County reports three new cases of whooping cough
item.description: FLOYD COUNTY, Ky. (ABC36 NEWS NOW) — The Floyd County Health Department is reporting three new cases of pertussis, also known as whooping cough, in Eastern Kentucky. According to the health department, the total number of confirmed pertussis cases has now risen to 17. item.title: Northern Kentucky child dies from flu, first pediatric death of the season
item.description: KENTON COUNTY, Ky. (ABC36 NEWS NOW) — A child in Northern Kentucky has died from the flu, according to the Kentucky Department for Public Health. Officials say the child was from Kenton County and had not received the recent influenza vaccine.
